```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
penguins <- palmerpenguins::penguins

mean(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)

boxplot(body_mass_g ~ species,penguins)

with(penguins,tapply(body_mass_g, species, mean, na.rm = TRUE))

heaviest_adelie <- max(penguins[penguins$species == 'Adelie', 'body_mass_g'], na.rm = TRUE)
sum(penguins$species == 'Gentoo' & penguins$body_mass_g > heaviest_adelie, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(penguins[penguins$species == 'Gentoo',])


cuts = quantile(penguins$body_mass_g, c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
penguins$size = cut(penguins$body_mass_g, breaks = cuts,
                    labels = c("light", "medium", "heavy"),
                    include.lowest = TRUE, ordered_result = TRUE)

adelie = subset(penguins, species == "Adelie")
island_year = table(adelie$island, adelie$year)
island_size = table(adelie$island, adelie$size)

mosaicplot(island_year,shade = TRUE,
           main = "Islands vs Years",
           las = 1)
mosaicplot(island_size,shade = TRUE,
           main = "Islands vs Size",
           las = 1)

chisq.test(island_year)
chisq.test(island_size)

chisq.test(island_year)$expected <= 5
chisq.test(island_size)$expected <= 5

fisher.test(island_size)

prop.table(island_year, margin = 1)


library(ggplot2)
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm)) +
    geom_histogram()

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = 'scatter')
```
